scope.mode: static integrity and provenance audit; no external requests were made during this audit

findings.title: Player context is unverified in all written high-confidence predictions
findings.detail: 18 of 18 written predictions have no player field and no player-level fact/source in the committed record. The player value is intentionally left blank here; do not infer a player from a roster.

findings.title: Some high-confidence narratives do not state a specific latest result
findings.detail: 5 narratives have form/score context but do not use a specific last-result sentence. Their fact lists still carry official last-five / head-to-head source links.

findings.title: NBA pricing remains withheld, not guessed
findings.detail: 50 NBA fixtures have no originated market because the snapshot recorded only 3 completed games and the declared threshold is 20. The archived NBA historical-results requests timed out; prices, probabilities and picks remain blank.

findings.title: ‘High-confidence winners’ and written-prediction totals measure different subsets
findings.detail: The snapshot's high_picks count is 13 match-winner picks, while 18 written high predictions include 2 handicap and 3 total selections. This is not a pricing error, but the label should not be read as the total number of written high selections.

findings.title: Cross-sport withheld-rationale label and grammar defect corrected
findings.detail: The static audit confirmed all 50 NBA withheld rows now identify the NBA and its three-game sample. The one generated ‘Recent form has … have’ construction was corrected in the current snapshot and future template.
